name: ARTEX operators (Chinese-nexus groups, moderate confidence)
description: Amazon decoy telemetry showed ARTEX agents building a real-time deepfake video pipeline (open-source face-animation model, ~11.5 fps on a consumer GPU) to defeat selfie liveness checks and submitting forged ID images with fake camera metadata for document verification. *Analyst note: Amazon reports the liveness vendor's server-side verdict rejected the deepfake in every attempt the agents recorded; it does not report document-check outcomes. Attempts, not confirmed account takeovers.* Amazon
